source_type: official public rule; constructed benchmark inputs

rule.source: Indiana Department of Revenue, Sales Tax Information Bulletin #55
rule.citation: The 100% exemption applies only when nontaxable utilities are separately metered and predominately used for exempt uses; predominately used means more than 50%; each meter is considered separately.
rule.expected_interpretation: strictly greater than 50 percent, evaluated one meter at a time

input_construction.exempt_use_units_per_month: case-specific; constructed to hit the stated ratio
input_construction.note: These are deterministic rule-boundary test values, not DOR-published customer records, bills, tariffs, or a certified utility study.
